# linearctl user

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl user list

```
List users in the workspace.

Fields: id, name, displayName, email, active, admin, guest, app

Usage:
  linearctl user list [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl user list --active --json

Flags:
      --active          only active users
      --app             only app users: the agents issues can be delegated to
      --cursor CURSOR   continue after CURSOR (nextCursor from the previous page)
      --fields FIELDS   return only these comma-separated FIELDS (see Fields above)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --limit N         show at most N items; 0 for all (default 50)
```
